conversion_contract.provenance: author release decision for this paper artifact. DIMACS documentation says transit weights are arbitrary, so this is a declared experimental normalization, not an official DIMACS physical-unit claim.
conversion_contract.rounding_policy: exact rational arithmetic internally where possible; deterministic decimal serialization with up to 9 digits after decimal, trimming trailing zeros

readiness.approval_scope: Prospective configuration only; no benchmark is started by this writer.
